source_name: World Bank WITS (World Integrated Trade Solution), mirroring UN Comtrade — India exports of HS 080610 by partner country, calendar year 2023
notes: Replaces an earlier dataset that had 5 country names but every value_usd/qty field null (private aggregator seair.co.in gave only an ordered destination list, no verifiable figures) — completely unusable for a market-data table. This WITS/UN Comtrade pull is the same primary-tier source used across the site's other 20+ trade-data files. Netherlands alone is ~39% of India's total fresh-grape export value, consistent with its role as the main EU re-distribution hub for Indian grapes. Full India world total for HS 080610, calendar 2023: USD 328,773,000 / 284,269,000 kg across 49 destination countries.
